#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate a team meeting ICS event: next Wednesday, 3-4 PM local time."""
from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta, timezone
import uuid

TZID = "America/New_York"
OUT = "team_meeting.ics"


def next_weekday_after(today: date, target: int) -> date:
    """Next occurrence of weekday `target` (Mon=0..Sun=6) strictly after today."""
    days_ahead = (target - today.weekday()) % 7
    if days_ahead == 0:
        days_ahead = 7
    return today + timedelta(days=days_ahead)


today = date.today()
meeting_date = next_weekday_after(today, 2)  # 2 == Wednesday

dtstart = datetime(meeting_date.year, meeting_date.month, meeting_date.day, 15, 0)
dtend = dtstart + timedelta(hours=1)
dtstamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc)

uid = f"{uuid.uuid4()}@company.com"

ics = f"""BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
PRODID:-//Company//Calendar Skill//EN
CALSCALE:GREGORIAN
METHOD:PUBLISH
BEGIN:VEVENT
UID:{uid}
DTSTAMP:{dtstamp.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')}
DTSTART;TZID={TZID}:{dtstart.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S')}
DTEND;TZID={TZID}:{dtend.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S')}
SUMMARY:Team Meeting
DESCRIPTION:Weekly team sync meeting
LOCATION:TBD
STATUS:CONFIRMED
TRANSP:OPAQUE
SEQUENCE:0
BEGIN:VALARM
ACTION:DISPLAY
DESCRIPTION:Team Meeting starting soon
TRIGGER:-PT15M
END:VALARM
END:VEVENT
END:VCALENDAR
"""

with open(OUT, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(ics)

print(f"Today: {today.isoformat()} ({today.strftime('%A')})")
print(f"Meeting date: {meeting_date.isoformat()} ({meeting_date.strftime('%A')})")
print(f"Start: {dtstart} ({TZID})")
print(f"End:   {dtend} ({TZID})")
print(f"Written to: {OUT}")
